findings.finding: Canonical supplied transaction and configured allocations are not bound to the retained encrypted aggregate intent resumed by the UI. Two same-scope USDC payments can have identical allocation amounts and unchanged beneficiary Ethereum nonce. A Ready result could concern payment B while the report attributes it to payment A.
findings.repair: Before resume, compare the actual decrypted saved aggregate record to the supplied canonical hash and original exact intent/plan; confirm the resulting saved claim is linked to it. Return only a boolean or safe public hash, never private custody.

findings.finding: Paid recovery wallet-operation attempt count is read only before returning. Unlike ordinary funding, no host-visible finalizer checks later forbidden attempts after browser teardown, and the report uses fixed zero counts.
findings.repair: Use a host-retained bounded counter or equivalent actual-used observer, preserve it on failure, and assert it in the caller post-context finalizer.
